documents.title: Approved Cedar Systems product information
documents.text: Cedar Systems provides workflow coordination and account reporting. A discovery meeting can establish integration requirements. No price, deployment timeline, uptime guarantee or specific vendor connector is approved here.

documents.title: Customer inquiry and call evidence
documents.text: Our regional logistics team struggles with approval delays. We want workflow coordination and account reporting. Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements. No budget has been approved.

raw_proposal.assessment: The customer explicitly mentions that their regional logistics team struggles with approval delays and that they want workflow coordination and account reporting. They have requested a discovery meeting to understand their requirements but have not yet approved a budget. The current stage is 'qualified' with verified consent and ownership, and no blocking prerequisites are in place.

claims.quote: Our regional logistics team struggles with approval delays.
We want workflow coordination and account reporting.
Please arrange a discovery meeting to understand our requirements.

raw_proposal.draft: Thank you for reaching out. We understand that your regional logistics team is currently facing challenges with approval delays, and you're seeking workflow coordination and account reporting solutions. A discovery meeting would be a great next step to better understand your specific requirements and how Cedar Systems can support your needs. We'll schedule a time that works best for your team.
questions: What specific workflows are currently causing delays in your regional logistics team?
Are there any existing systems or tools that you're currently using for workflow coordination or account reporting?
What are your expectations for the discovery meeting in terms of scope and outcomes?
uncertainties: The customer has not yet approved a budget, which may impact the timeline or scope of the proposed solution.
The specific integration requirements and existing systems are not yet known.
